Executive Order 12783 of December 17, 1991
Extending the Presid ent’s C ouncil on R ural A m erica
#
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the laws of 
the United States of America, and in order to extend the President’s Council 
on Rural America, it is hereby ordered that Executive Order No. 12720 is 
amended by deleting the text of section 3(e) and inserting in lieu thereof “The 
Council shall terminate on January 16,1993."
e i / \ s z s C \ ^

operative_clauses.judgment_reason: Section 1(a) establishes the Council, of not more than twenty members appointed by the President. This clause exists only for the President's Council on Rural America (EO 12720 section 1(a)), so it has no independent life once the Council terminates. Section 3(e) of the order, as amended by Executive Order 12783 (56 FR 65977, signed 1991-12-17), provides that the Council terminates on January 16, 1993; the amending order provides that EO 12720 is "amended by deleting the text of section 3(e) and inserting in lieu thereof" the new termination date, and it contains no effective-date provision of its own, so it is taken as effective on signing, 1991-12-17. The date is recorded as 1993-01-16 (the stated day); the alternative reading is that the Council ceased as that day began. No held later order extends the Council past that date. Executive Order 12869 (58 FR 51751; effective 1993-09-30: "This order shall be effective") later revoked EO 12720 as amended, reciting committees "that have terminated or whose work is"; that revocation is a later formal event, not the first end.

This clause exists only for the President's Council on Rural America (EO 12720 section 1(a)), so it has no independent life once the Council terminates. Section 3(e) of the order, as amended by Executive Order 12783 (56 FR 65977, signed 1991-12-17), provides that the Council terminates on January 16, 1993; the amending order provides that EO 12720 is "amended by deleting the text of section 3(e) and inserting in lieu thereof" the new termination date, and it contains no effective-date provision of its own, so it is taken as effective on signing, 1991-12-17. ic development policy.

nomic development policy as deemed necessary or appropriate by the Coun­

research_rationale:
Whole order ended by its own fixed sunset. EO 12720 (55 FR 29337, 1990-07-16) created the President's Council on Rural America with nine operative provisions, all existing for the Council; section 3(e) terminated it after 2 years, and EO 12783 (56 FR 65977, 1991-12-17) replaced that with termination on January 16, 1993. Every clause is therefore recorded terminated on 1993-01-16 (stated day, inclusive reading; exclusive reading: ended as that day began), by the order's own terms as amended. EO 12869 (58 FR 51751) then formally revoked the order effective 1993-09-30, which is recorded as a later event on every clause and not as the first end. This is a replacement proposal for the frozen sol-2026-10-18 upstream proposal, which reached the same first-end date; this version separates the EO 12783 amendment and the EO 12869 revocation as later events, uses all nine disjoint spans, and states the exclusive reading. The text relied on is the government-printed Federal Register text held as machine-read OCR; page images were not inspected, so original_pages_confirmed is false.
